summary: Added native directory source/build/artifact/ABI admission and VerifyDirectory; verified the real PR23 bundle and the full effectqualification suite.
limitations: Source pin bytes and clean Git metadata are internally checked; Git history and verifier-build provenance are not authenticated.
Build output bytes and ABI consistency are independently checked, but the compiler is not invoked or authenticated.
The verifier does not launch a browser or count producer mutation-control booleans as Go-executed negative-control proof.
modulequalification.VerifyArchive is schema-incompatible with the module-effects execution snapshot; N6 is implementing the effects-specific archive verifier.
